clips.title: The story
paras: Troggs have taken Bingles' Hammer from the crash site in Loch Modan. Bingles Blastenheimer, a stranded gnome aviator, needs his specialized gear to repair his flying machine and help free Gnomeregan.

Bingles Blastenheimer survived his flying machine's plunge into the Loch, then lost his tools to troggs on the freshwater islands. They took his hammer and high-potency explosives from the crash site. He needs the hammer to repair the dented airframe and adjust the gyrocopter's mechanical parts. Without his equipment, Bingles cannot fly support runs for the gnome forces fighting to reclaim Gnomeregan.
